facts.label: Cuidar das plantas
facts.sub: Quando um vizinho viaja, é comum cuidar das plantas dele. Receba a chave, ouça as instruções e anote a frequência da rega.

facts.label: Quanta água
facts.sub: Cada planta precisa de uma quantidade diferente. Plantas grandes pedem mais, e as pequenas, menos. Água demais pode matar a planta.

pages.title: Green leaves · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday afternoon on a quiet street in Denver. Lena packs a big suitcase on her porch. She is going to visit her sister for a week. Her house is full of green plants. Her neighbor Teo walks by with his dog. She calls him with a smile.
“Teo, can you water my plants next week?” says Lena. “Sure! How often do they need water?” says Teo. “The big ones every two days. The small ones once a week.” says Lena.
